About Me

Professional Profile

Multidisciplinary expertise bridging technology, maritime & governance

A highly motivated and results-driven professional with a strong combined background in Shipping & Maritime Operations, IT & Networking, and Auditing & Accounting. Holds a Master's degree in Computer Science and possesses multidisciplinary expertise integrating operational logistics, financial oversight, and technology-driven systems.

Demonstrates solid experience in port and container handling, shipping documentation, customs clearance, and maritime regulatory compliance, alongside formal training in business accounting, payroll systems, auditing principles, and financial statement analysis. Equipped with strong technical capabilities in network administration, cybersecurity, database systems, and IT support.

Recognized for the ability to bridge operational workflows, financial controls, and IT solutions to enhance efficiency, compliance, transparency, and service delivery. Known for strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, time management, teamwork, and leadership abilities, with proven performance in fast-paced environments.

Research Statement

"I am a Computer Science graduate specializing in the intersection of Information Technology and Public Governance. My research focuses on designing secure, scalable, and interoperable digital governance architectures for emerging and developing states. My objective is to bridge the structural gap between ICT infrastructure design and institutional governance systems through applied systems engineering and cybersecurity frameworks."

PhD

PhD Research Agenda

Designing the digital future for emerging states

Proposed Research Title

"Designing Secure and Scalable Digital Governance Architectures for Emerging States"

Research Problem

Many emerging states lack integrated, secure, and interoperable digital governance infrastructures. There is often a structural disconnect between ICT system implementation and governance frameworks.

Research Objectives

  • Develop a scalable e-governance architecture model
  • Integrate cybersecurity frameworks into national public systems
  • Design interoperability standards across ministries
  • Propose a policy-technology alignment framework

Methodology

  • Comparative analysis of EU digital governance systems
  • Systems architecture modeling
  • Cybersecurity risk assessment
  • Prototype framework development
  • Case study validation

Expected Contribution

  • A digital governance reference architecture model
  • A cybersecurity-integrated public systems blueprint
  • An adaptable framework for developing and post-conflict states

Publications

Working Papers & Ongoing Research

All manuscripts authored by Khadar Ali Aqli (2026)

Maritime & Logistics

Shipping Line & Maritime Logistics Operations

This working paper examines operational frameworks within international shipping lines, with a focus on port logistics efficiency, container handling workflows, and IT-driven documentation systems. Drawing on field experience at Pacific International Lines, it proposes improvements to maritime supply chain coordination in emerging port economies.

View Publication Download PDF
Governance & IT

Government Digital Systems & IT Governance

This paper investigates the structural design of government digital systems, examining how IT governance frameworks can be applied to strengthen public sector institutional capacity. It addresses interoperability challenges, cybersecurity policy integration, and the alignment between national ICT strategies and e-government delivery in developing and post-conflict states.

View Publication Download PDF
Infrastructure

IT Infrastructure & Network Systems Architecture

This technical paper presents a comprehensive analysis of IT infrastructure design principles, covering network topology, routing and switching protocols, cybersecurity hardening, and system resilience. It proposes a scalable architecture model suitable for deployment in resource-constrained institutional environments in the Horn of Africa region.

View Publication Download PDF

Logistics Tracking Web App

Visibility · Coordination · Delay Reduction

Network Security Monitoring Tool

Monitoring · Detection · Cyber Resilience
  • Challenge: Operational networks need better visibility to detect anomalies before they turn into outages or security incidents.
  • Approach: Built a security-oriented monitoring concept using packet analysis logic and alerting ideas for suspicious activity.
  • Value: Strengthens awareness, troubleshooting speed, and cyber readiness for institutional and logistics environments.

AI Logistics Optimizer
